pcs.pc_description: define the format, structure, and statistical requirements of the research/ clinical dataset to ensure compatibility with analytical methods.
establish indexing strategies and organize variables systematically for efficient statistical computation

validate pre-processed data using statistical diagnostics, such as descriptive statistics and outlier detection methods.
ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR) while maintaining data integrity for analysis.
identify statistical objectives, such as trend analysis, hypothesis testing, or predictive modelling, to guide data visualization.
define the purpose, scope, and target audience for statistical reporting of results
determine the optimal delivery mode and format (e.g., interactive dashboards, statistical reports, apis) for conveying insights.
summarize key statistical findings from the research/ clinical dataset into a structured and meaningful narrative.
select appropriate visualization techniques (e.g., box plots, histograms, kaplan-meier survival curves, forest plots) to represent statistical results effectively.
present statistical outputs using standardized templates and consistent language for clarity and reproducibility.
validate visualizations by cross-referencing with statistical outputs and stakeholder feedback.
publish validated visualizations in agreed formats for dissemination across research, regulatory, and industry platforms.
